unit.why: A short anecdote: an ascetic who fasted from Sabbath to Sabbath and wore sackcloth came before the Maggid of Kozienice, who replied with a pointed teaching on excessive fasting.

stories.start_quote: כי פ"א בא לפני המגיד מקאזניץ
stories.end_quote: כי הוא מאנה גם עצמו עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: A man who fasted from Sabbath to Sabbath and wore sackcloth came before the Maggid of Kozienice, who told him the evil inclination had entered him through the sack, and that one who only claims to fast while eating in secret deceives others, but the real faster deceives himself as well.
